For the basic captioner in context-aware image description (Section 3.1), we choose the BLIP2-flant5xxl (Li et al., 2023) as our baseline. For CVR-ICL phase (Section 3.2), we employ BM25 (Robertson et al., 1995) and BLIP2 multi-embedding (Li et al., 2023) to encode text and multi-modal inputs, respectively. For our LLMs, we choose three popular LLMs as inference models for generation tests including: Llama3-8B (Dubey et al., 2024) for CVRLLMLlama3, GPT3.5 (OpenAI, 2023) for CVRLLMGPT3.5, and GPT4 (Achiam et al., 2023) for CVRLLMGPT4. Performance comparisons are conducted directly on the test set without any finetuning, as WinoGAViL, Winoground, and NYCC datasets are exclusively for testing purposes.
